natural: Changing dynasties and replacing reigns

meaning.en: A change of dynasty or regime; a complete changeover.
meaning.zh: 旧的朝代为新的朝代所代替。泛指政权更替。

examples.zh: 中国历史上经历了多次改朝换代。
examples.en: Chinese history has seen many changes of dynasty.

examples.zh: 手机行业几年就改朝换代一次。
examples.en: The phone industry sees a changing of the guard every few years.

usage.en: Predicate. Also figurative for leadership or industry changes.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，也可比喻行业更替。

natural: Forgetting kindness and betraying loyalty

meaning.en: Ungrateful; to repay kindness with betrayal.
meaning.zh: 忘记别人对自己的恩德，做出对不起别人的事。

equivalents: bite the hand that feeds you

examples.zh: 老板帮了他那么多，他却忘恩负义。
examples.en: The boss helped him so much, yet he bit the hand that fed him.

examples.zh: 做人不能忘恩负义。
examples.en: Never be ungrateful.

natural: Eating the fruit of one's own planting

meaning.en: To reap what one has sown; to suffer the consequences of one's own actions.
meaning.zh: 自己做了坏事，自己受到损害或惩罚。

examples.zh: 他欺骗别人，最终自食其果。
examples.en: He cheated others and eventually got his comeuppance.

examples.zh: 破坏环境，人类终将自食其果。
examples.en: If we destroy the environment, we'll reap what we sow.

natural: Heavy head and light feet

meaning.en: Light-headed and dizzy; top-heavy (also of structures or writing).
meaning.zh: 头脑发胀，脚下无力。形容身体不适，也比喻基础不稳或主次颠倒。

examples.zh: 感冒了，我觉得头重脚轻。
examples.en: I've got a cold and feel light-headed.

examples.zh: 这篇文章开头太长，头重脚轻。
examples.en: The essay's introduction is too long — it's top-heavy.

natural: Content wherever one finds oneself

meaning.en: To take things as they come; adaptable and content.
meaning.zh: 能顺应环境，在任何境遇中都能满足。

examples.zh: 他性格随遇而安，在哪儿都能过得很好。
examples.en: He takes things as they come and is happy anywhere.

examples.zh: 年轻人不能太随遇而安，要有追求。
examples.en: Young people shouldn't just drift — they need ambitions.

usage.en: Predicate. Can be praise (adaptable) or mild criticism (unambitious).

natural: A lone body and a single shadow

meaning.en: All alone; solitary.
meaning.zh: 只有一个身体，一个影子。形容孤独。

examples.zh: 妻子去世后，他形单影只。
examples.en: After his wife died, he was all alone.

examples.zh: 节日里她形单影只，很想家。
examples.en: Alone at the holiday, she was very homesick.

story.en: Han Yu, mourning his nephew, recalled that in two generations only they two carried on the family line: "two generations in one body — a single body and a lone shadow" (两世一身，形单影只).
story.zh: 韩愈《祭十二郎文》："两世一身，形单影只。"

natural: One word as weighty as nine bronze tripods

meaning.en: One's word carries great weight; as good as one's word.
meaning.zh: 一句话的分量像九鼎那样重。形容说话有分量，起决定作用。

examples.zh: 他在公司一言九鼎。
examples.en: In the company his word is law.

examples.zh: 男子汉说话要一言九鼎。
examples.en: A man should be as good as his word.

story.en: After Mao Sui's speech won Chu's alliance, Lord Pingyuan said: "With one visit to Chu, Mr Mao made Zhao weightier than the nine tripods and great bells" (使赵重于九鼎大吕).
story.zh: 平原君说："毛先生一至楚，而使赵重于九鼎大吕。"

usage.en: Predicate. 九鼎 = the nine bronze tripods, symbols of state power.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"九鼎"为国家权力的象征。

natural: The end of a powerful crossbow's flight

meaning.en: A spent force.
meaning.zh: 强弩射出的箭，到最后力量弱了。比喻很强的力量已经衰竭。

examples.zh: 敌军已是强弩之末，不堪一击。
examples.en: The enemy is a spent force and will collapse at a touch.

examples.zh: 这轮上涨已是强弩之末。
examples.en: This rally is running out of steam.

story.en: Han Anguo argued against attacking the Xiongnu far away: "At the end of its flight, a powerful crossbow bolt cannot pierce even thin Lu silk."
story.zh: 韩安国说："强弩之极，矢不能穿鲁缟。"

usage.en: Object, usually 已是强弩之末.

natural: Beaming with satisfaction

meaning.en: Smug and pleased with oneself.
meaning.zh: 形容非常得意的样子。

equivalents: like the cat that got the cream

examples.zh: 他赢了比赛，得意洋洋地走上领奖台。
examples.en: Having won, he strode to the podium pleased as Punch.

examples.zh: 看他那得意洋洋的样子，真让人受不了。
examples.en: His smug look is unbearable.

usage.en: Adverbial or attributive. Often slightly critical.
usage.zh: 多作状语、定语，常带贬义。

natural: Seeming to understand but not really

meaning.en: To half-understand; only vaguely grasp.
meaning.zh: 好像懂，又好像不懂。

equivalents: get the gist but not the details

examples.zh: 老师讲的内容我似懂非懂。
examples.en: I only half understood what the teacher explained.

examples.zh: 孩子似懂非懂地点了点头。
examples.en: The child nodded, only half understanding.

natural: Making noise in the east, striking in the west

meaning.en: To make a feint; feint east, attack west.
meaning.zh: 表面上声言要攻打东边，实际上却攻打西边。比喻制造假象，出奇制胜。

examples.zh: 球队声东击西，左路佯攻，右路得分。
examples.en: The team feinted down the left and scored on the right.

examples.zh: 他用声东击西的办法转移了大家的注意力。
examples.en: He used misdirection to divert everyone's attention.

story.en: The military compendium Tongdian: "Announce an attack in the east, but in fact strike the west" (声言击东，其实击西). Also one of the Thirty-Six Stratagems.
story.zh: 《通典·兵典》："声言击东，其实击西。"为三十六计之一。

natural: Not contending with the world

meaning.en: To stand aloof from worldly strife; unambitious and peaceable.
meaning.zh: 不跟社会上的人发生争执。指一种消极回避的处世态度，也指淡泊名利。

equivalents: keep out of the rat race

examples.zh: 他退休后过着与世无争的生活。
examples.en: Since retiring he's lived a quiet life away from the rat race.

examples.zh: 她性格温和，与世无争。
examples.en: She's gentle and peaceable.

natural: Think three times, then act

meaning.en: Look before you leap; think carefully before acting.
meaning.zh: 经过反复考虑，然后再去做。

examples.zh: 这件事关系重大，请三思而行。
examples.en: This matters a lot — please think twice.

examples.zh: 投资前要三思而行。
examples.en: Look before you leap when investing.

story.en: "Ji Wenzi thought three times before acting." Hearing this, Confucius said: "Twice is enough" (再，斯可矣).
story.zh: 《论语》："季文子三思而后行。子闻之，曰：'再，斯可矣。'"

natural: The lonely one, the one of little virtue

meaning.en: A loner with no supporters; someone isolated.
meaning.zh: 古代君主的谦称。现指脱离群众、孤立无助的人。

examples.zh: 他得罪了所有人，成了孤家寡人。
examples.en: He's offended everyone and ended up completely isolated.

examples.zh: 同学们都回家了，宿舍里只剩我一个孤家寡人。
examples.en: Everyone went home, leaving me all on my own in the dorm.

usage.en: Object. Originally humble terms rulers used for themselves (孤 "the orphan", 寡人 "the one of little virtue").
usage.zh: 多作宾语。原为古代君王的自称。

natural: Nourishing energy and storing strength

meaning.en: To conserve energy and build strength for the challenge ahead.
meaning.zh: 保养精神，蓄集锐气。

examples.zh: 比赛前一天要养精蓄锐。
examples.en: Rest up the day before the match.

examples.zh: 军队养精蓄锐，准备反攻。
examples.en: The army built up its strength for a counter-attack.

natural: The bitterness ends and sweetness comes

meaning.en: After hardship comes happiness.
meaning.zh: 艰难困苦的日子过完了，美好的日子来到了。

equivalents: every cloud has a silver lining

examples.zh: 熬过了最难的几年，他们终于苦尽甘来。
examples.en: Having come through the hardest years, things finally turned sweet for them.

examples.zh: 坚持下去，总会苦尽甘来。
examples.en: Hang in there — good times will come.

natural: Not trimming one's edges

meaning.en: Careless about one's appearance; scruffy.
meaning.zh: 形容不拘小节，不注意衣着、仪容的整洁。

equivalents: look like something the cat dragged in

examples.zh: 他是个不修边幅的科学家，一心只想着研究。
examples.en: He's a scruffy scientist who thinks only of his research.

examples.zh: 面试时不能不修边幅。
examples.en: You can't turn up to an interview looking unkempt.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. Sometimes affectionate about absent-minded geniuses.

natural: Pointing at a deer and calling it a horse

meaning.en: To deliberately distort the truth (to test or force loyalty).
meaning.zh: 指着鹿，说是马。比喻故意颠倒黑白，混淆是非。

examples.zh: 他指鹿为马，硬说错误的数据是对的。
examples.en: He called black white, insisting the wrong figures were right.

examples.zh: 在那个单位，没人敢反驳领导的指鹿为马。
examples.en: In that office, no one dared contradict the boss's distortions.

story.en: The eunuch Zhao Gao, testing the court, presented a deer to the Second Emperor and called it a horse. Those who said "deer" were later secretly eliminated.
story.zh: 赵高献鹿给秦二世，说是马。群臣有的说是鹿，赵高后来暗中陷害了说真话的人。

natural: The verdict is settled when the coffin is closed

meaning.en: A final verdict on someone's life (only possible after death).
meaning.zh: 指人死后才能作出最后结论。

equivalents: it's not over till it's over

examples.zh: 一个人的功过，往往要盖棺定论。
examples.en: A person's merits and faults can often only be judged at the end.

examples.zh: 现在评价他还为时过早，不能盖棺定论。
examples.en: It's too early to pass final judgement on him.

story.en: Du Fu wrote to a downcast young friend: "A man's affairs are only settled when the coffin is closed" (丈夫盖棺事始定).

usage.en: Predicate. Often negated: 不能/难以盖棺定论.

literal: go into · boiling water · tread · fire
natural: Plunging into boiling water and treading on fire

meaning.en: To go through fire and water; to brave any danger.
meaning.zh: 沸水敢蹚，烈火敢踏。比喻不避艰险，奋不顾身。

equivalents: go to the ends of the earth

examples.zh: 为了朋友，他愿意赴汤蹈火。
examples.en: He'd go through fire and water for his friends.

examples.zh: 只要国家需要，我们赴汤蹈火在所不辞。
examples.en: If the country needs us, we'll brave any danger.

story.en: Chao Cuo argued that soldiers well treated would "brave arrows and stones and plunge into boiling water and fire" (蒙矢石，赴汤火) without regard for death.
story.zh: 《汉书·晁错传》："蒙矢石，赴汤火，视死如生。"

usage.en: Predicate. Often 赴汤蹈火，在所不辞.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，常说"赴汤蹈火，在所不辞"。

natural: Using big timber for small jobs

meaning.en: A waste of talent; using a talented person for petty tasks.
meaning.zh: 把大的材料当作小的材料用。比喻使用不当，浪费人才。

equivalents: using a sledgehammer to crack a nut

examples.zh: 让博士去发传单，真是大材小用。
examples.en: Having a PhD hand out flyers is a real waste of talent.

examples.zh: 他觉得这份工作大材小用。
examples.en: He feels overqualified for the job.

origin.source: 宋·陆游《送辛幼安殿撰造朝》

story.en: Lu You lamented that the great general-poet Xin Qiji was wasted in minor posts: "Great timber put to small use — since ancient times men have sighed at it" (大材小用古所叹).
story.zh: 陆游送辛弃疾："大材小用古所叹，管仲萧何实流亚。"

natural: Reading widely across many books

meaning.en: Widely read.
meaning.zh: 广泛地阅读各种书籍。

examples.zh: 他博览群书，知识渊博。
examples.en: He's widely read and very knowledgeable.

examples.zh: 要写好文章，首先要博览群书。
examples.en: To write well, you first need to read widely.

natural: When the melon ripens, the stalk drops off

meaning.en: Things happen naturally when the time is right.
meaning.zh: 瓜熟了，瓜蒂自然脱落。比喻条件成熟，事情自然会成功。

examples.zh: 不用着急，到时候自然瓜熟蒂落。
examples.en: Don't rush — it'll happen naturally when the time is right.

examples.zh: 两人恋爱多年，结婚是瓜熟蒂落的事。
examples.en: After years together, marriage came naturally.

natural: Shooting arrows with no target

meaning.en: To act or speak without a clear aim; aimless.
meaning.zh: 没有目标乱放箭。比喻说话做事没有明确目的，不切合实际。

examples.zh: 批评要有针对性，不能无的放矢。
examples.en: Criticism must be targeted, not aimless.

examples.zh: 不了解市场就做广告，是无的放矢。
examples.en: Advertising without understanding the market is shooting in the dark.

usage.en: Predicate. 的 is dì (target). Popularised in 20th-century political writing, opposite of 有的放矢.
usage.zh: 多作谓语。"的"读 dì。与"有的放矢"相对。

natural: A heavenly maiden scattering flowers

meaning.en: Flowers (or things) scattering down beautifully everywhere.
meaning.zh: 原为佛教故事。现形容大雪纷飞或抛洒东西的样子。

examples.zh: 雪花像天女散花一样飘落下来。
examples.en: Snowflakes drifted down like flowers scattered from heaven.

examples.zh: 他把传单天女散花似的撒了出去。
examples.en: He scattered the flyers far and wide.

story.en: In the Vimalakirti Sutra, a heavenly maiden scatters flowers on the assembly: they slide off the bodhisattvas but stick to disciples still attached to the world.
story.zh: 《维摩诘经》载，天女以天花散在菩萨和弟子身上，花至菩萨即落，至弟子便著不坠。

usage.en: Adverbial or simile (像天女散花一样). Also a famous Peking opera.
usage.zh: 多作状语或比喻。也是京剧名剧。
